old_source.version: Iowa State dissertation, August 2023, Chapter 3 (author manuscript)

new_source.title: A blockwise empirical likelihood method for time series in frequency domain inference
new_source.version: Published version, The Annals of Statistics 52(3), 2024, pp. 1152-1177

findings: All four complete published theorem statements were checked against the rendered source. The printed numbering is 1,2,3,4; the earlier chapter numbers are retained only in this mapping.
Theorem 4 retains the infinite block-size limit despite importing a zero limit. The overlapping-periodogram normalization mismatch also persists.
The published smooth-function introduction has consistent dimensions vartheta in R^s and h:R^p to R^s, unlike the dissertation introduction.
The published bootstrap description omits the dissertation exact percentile-CDF equality; this old-only passage will not be carried into the new census.
The published main text contains Corollary 1 for Whittle estimators, excluded from the Theorem inventory. No appendix body was consulted.
active_source_policy: Use the registered published PDF and the published census; the dissertation source and artifacts are historical.
